reviews.text: Excellent service from the very first moment. I've been taking my Bichon Frise to rehabilitation since this summer, and from the moment I called to inquire until today, I'm very happy. They are very professional and caring with him. We were very lucky to find Alberto, María, and the whole team.

I've been going there for six months with my three dogs, and so far, all three vets seem like good professionals—attentive and they explain everything really well. The prices are typical, neither cheap nor expensive. So far, they've been great, and they'll continue to be my go-to clinic!

The service was outstanding, and they were true professionals.
Pepito helped us in our final moments.

My experience with this clinic has not been good, especially regarding the emergency service.

The center advertises that it has an emergency service, but in practice, it seems that an "emergency" simply means offering you an appointment when they have an opening. If the animal needs immediate attention, the usual response is to recommend going to another clinic.

Furthermore, I believe the reception staff needs significant improvement. On several occasions, I've had the impression that they don't properly differentiate between a routine consultation and a situation that may require urgent veterinary care.

I completely understand that a clinic may have staffing or capacity limitations, but then I think they should clearly indicate what type of emergency service they offer, to prevent owners from arriving expecting immediate attention and ending up being referred to another center.

In my case, it doesn't seem like a suitable place if you're looking for a truly available emergency veterinary service when an unexpected situation arises.
Excellent service and professional quality. We've been coming here for many years and the service has always been fantastic. Highly recommended.

I've known their team for years, and they've always demonstrated a high level of professionalism and exceptional service.

Just yesterday, I contacted their emergency service and received immediate attention, which allowed them to effectively resolve a problem related to injuries to my dog's ears.

I highly recommend their services.
The best vet in the neighborhood, where we've been taking our little ones for many years and they've always treated us wonderfully, with very professional and friendly staff <3

Super professional and friendly. 10 out of 10. Frida is thrilled with her trip and she's truly devoted to Alberto. It's such a blessing to have met them; they're also incredibly thoughtful. Thank you for everything.

Amazing! They're incredibly professional. The way they treated my dog ​​Lola and explained everything was spectacular. I'm so happy with the service I received. You can tell they're veterinarians who love their work and animals, and that they do it out of passion, not just to make money. Alberto is a true professional, as is his team. Without a doubt, it's the best clinic I know. Thank you for the wonderful service.

Always available to help, very kind and attentive. They treat my cat Minnie with so much love and dedication. I haven't had any problems with the spaying and they've helped me with everything. Thank you so much!

Very happy with the way my cats were treated 🐈‍⬛ and very professional
Thank you so much 😻 …
What a wonderful team! Besides being great professionals, they have a remarkable kindness and empathy. Thank you for taking such good care of Turrón.
I would give it 7 stars if possible. Super professional and wonderful service. Alberto is exceptional. I couldn't be more grateful for how they always take care of my dog.
Excellent service for us and our cat. They dedicate a lot of time to his care. Very professional. 100% recommended.
Great clinic, a relative recommended them to me when we returned to Madrid from Mallorca and I couldn't be happier.
Very professional. Very satisfied with the service.

Highly professional and friendly veterinarians. They always take the time to explain everything in detail and make sure you fully understand the diagnosis, treatments, and care your pet needs. Thank you for your time and dedication!
Excellent service...very professional with my dog. Highly recommended.
Excellent treatment of pets and owners. It's clear they know what they're doing.

I took my cat for his annual check-up and I loved it! Excellent customer service, and even better with the animals; they clearly have a real knack for cats. Everyone was super friendly and professional. I'm very happy!
Very friendly and welcoming service, reasonable prices

What I'm looking for for my dogs is someone who will love them as if they were their own.
A great team! 👏👏👏👌 …
Our association is incredibly fortunate to have you nearby and always ready to help. Thank you on behalf of all the cats you have cared for so diligently and the entire Madrid Felina team.
Careful and prompt attention
They are great professionals and very dedicated; we took our three pets there and they helped ensure that the last years of our dog's life, despite having several illnesses, were of good quality.

An example of excellent care, knowledge, responsibility, and professionalism. I've had them for 10 years now, and I wouldn't trade them for anything... neither would my cat.

Now, I've rescued two black cats, and they continue to be an example of professionalism, care, and dedication.

Whenever we call in an emergency, they answer and try to schedule an appointment as soon as possible. Both Dr. Maria and Dr. [Name] are excellent veterinarians and always grateful for every consultation. They explain everything in detail and their service is very professional. Total confidence. 👌 …

The veterinarian, Alberto, is exceptional. He operated on Bora, a mastiff puppy who arrived with a broken leg. He couldn't have been kinder, and his professionalism was outstanding. I recommend him without hesitation.
Super friendly and helpful service. Very affordable prices. They're lovely.
Simply... Perfect!!!!
